import json,urllib.request,time,collections
bt=json.load(open('/tmp/robot_bt.json'))
d=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen('http://localhost:8091/api/runs',timeout=60))
live=[]
first=min(r['start_ms'] for r in d['runs'] if r.get('track')=='bot')
for r in d['runs']:
    if r.get('track')!='bot': continue
    for x in r['trades']:
        live.append((r['sym'],r['cfg']['tf'],x['t_in'],x['side']))
L=set(live)
B=[(t['sym'],t['tf'],t['t_in'],t['side']) for t in bt if t['t_in']>=first]
Bs=set(B)
print('first_run_start_utc',time.strftime('%m-%d %H:%M',time.gmtime(first/1000)))
print('live trades',len(L),'backtest trades since then',len(Bs),'common',len(L&Bs))
by=collections.Counter(k[1] for k in L); byb=collections.Counter(k[1] for k in Bs); byc=collections.Counter(k[1] for k in (L&Bs))
for tf in sorted(by|byb): print(tf,'live',by[tf],'bt',byb[tf],'common',byc[tf])
